name: Black Bean Burrito Bowls with Cilantro Lime Brown Rice

components.name: Spiced Black Beans
steps: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil for 5-7 minutes; add garlic and ground spices.
Add drained black beans and splash of water, simmer until heated through, and lightly mash some beans to bind.
Portion rice and beans in four containers and store fresh tomato, feta and avocado separately.
Freeze only the rice and bean mixture, not the avocado or fresh tomato topping.

components.name: Cilantro Lime Brown Rice
steps: Cook brown rice in measured water until tender; rest covered and stir through lime juice and coriander after cooking.

components.name: Tomato, Avocado & Feta

ingredients.name: Fresh ripe avocado flesh, added just before serving

steps: Dice tomatoes; cut avocado only when serving to prevent browning.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or within 1 hour if ambient temperatures exceed 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or colder for up to 3-4 days; freeze later-week portions promptly. If freshly prepared salad is included, prepare and store separately.
Reheat previously cooked leftovers to 74 C, stirring and checking the centre. For egg dishes, ensure eggs are completely set before portioning.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
